_about: Controlled synthetic benchmark for the PlagiarismMatcher. NOT real-world prevalence: each passage is deliberately authored. Positives are copies/paraphrases/translations of the sources; negatives are original text (same-topic, boilerplate, ESL, shared-terminology, unrelated) that must NOT be flagged. Used as a regression + failure-mode gauge.

sources.name: Transformers
sources.text: The transformer architecture relies entirely on self-attention mechanisms to draw global dependencies between input and output sequences. Multi-head attention allows the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces at different positions. Positional encodings inject information about the order of the tokens because the model contains no recurrence.

sources.name: Density clustering
sources.text: Density-based clustering automatically determines the number of clusters present in a dataset without requiring a preset count parameter. Points that lie in low-density regions are labelled as noise rather than being forced into a cluster. The approach is robust to clusters of arbitrary shape and varying size.

sources.name: Stylometry
sources.text: Stylometric analysis measures an author's involuntary linguistic fingerprint through quantifiable features such as vocabulary richness and function-word frequency. These invariants tend to remain stable across the body of writing produced by a single author. Because paraphrasing changes the words but not the underlying habits, the fingerprint often survives light editing.

sources.text: L'apprentissage profond a transformé le traitement automatique du langage naturel au cours de la dernière décennie. Les grands modèles pré-entraînés atteignent des performances élevées sur de nombreuses tâches de compréhension du texte. Le réglage fin sur des données spécifiques améliore encore la qualité des prédictions.

sources.name: Computer vision (ES)
sources.text: Las redes neuronales convolucionales han revolucionado la visión por computador al aprender características jerárquicas directamente de los píxeles. El aumento de datos mejora la generalización cuando el conjunto de entrenamiento es pequeño. La normalización por lotes acelera el entrenamiento y estabiliza la convergencia.

sources.text: Bestärkendes Lernen ermöglicht es einem Agenten, durch Versuch und Irrtum optimale Handlungen in einer Umgebung zu erlernen. Die Belohnungsfunktion steuert das Verhalten des Agenten über viele Zeitschritte hinweg. Erfahrungswiederholung verbessert die Stabilität des Trainings tiefer neuronaler Netze.
